title: Bicep: modules, parameters, what-if and the deployment stack

videos.script: One Bicep file is fine for one storage account. {{one}} The shop has two environments, a dozen resources, and a password nobody should commit. So the file splits into modules, and the values move into parameter files. {{split}} Then two questions only Azure can answer. What would this deployment change? That is what-if. {{whatif}} And what happens to a resource you delete from the file? Left alone, it stays and is billed. A deployment stack is how it goes. {{stack}} You will build the first half here, and read the second from Microsoft's documentation. {{end}}
